posts.post: The moment you understand that comfort is a tax on your future, you will stop seeking it. Every luxury you buy before you can afford it is a debt of time you are forcing your future self to pay back. Pay the debt now or pay it with interest later.

How to know if you are winning: You no longer feel the need to argue with people who are wrong. You let them stay wrong. While they debate, you build. Silence is a competitive advantage in a world addicted to noise.

Fun fact: Talent is the most overrated variable in the game. Consistency is just boredom management. The people at the top are not special. They are just the ones who stayed in the room long enough for everyone else to leave.
